data.name: San Diego Tours:Ensenada Pacific Coastline Tour from San Diego (Private)
data.description:
Discover the coastal beauty and cultural charm of Ensenada on this full-day adventure from San Diego. From the bustling Seafood Black Market to scenic ocean promenades and vibrant local shops, this experience captures the heart of Baja California’s most beloved port city.

Ideal for travelers seeking a relaxed yet immersive cultural escape, this tour offers the perfect blend of flavors, history, and stunning ocean views—all with the comfort of round-trip transportation and a bilingual local guide.
data.highlights:
Scenic drive along the Pacific Coast from San Diego to Ensenada

Visit the famous Seafood Black Market (Mercado Negro) for fresh local catches

Walk along El Malecón, Ensenada’s iconic seaside promenade

Explore La Calle Primera, full of shops, local crafts, and souvenirs

Enjoy free time for shopping or lunch at a traditional seafood restaurant

Border-crossing assistance and insights from your bilingual guide
data.itinerary:
9:00 AM – Pick-Up in San Diego
Meet your guide and depart southbound for Baja California via scenic coastal highway.

11:30 AM – Arrival in Ensenada
Start with a visit to the Seafood Black Market (Mercado Negro)—one of the most iconic culinary landmarks of the region.

12:15 PM – El Malecón Walk
Enjoy a guided walk along the oceanfront boardwalk and soak in panoramic views of the Pacific.

1:00 PM – Calle Primera Exploration
Free time to shop, grab coffee, and explore artisan boutiques and souvenir stores.

2:00 PM – Optional Lunch Time
Dine at a local seafood restaurant (meal not included). Your guide can offer recommendations based on your preferences.

3:30 PM – Scenic Return Drive
Depart Ensenada and enjoy the beautiful coastal route back north.

7:00 PM – Drop-Off in San Diego

data.cancellation_notes:
There are no refunds. All tours are subject to cancellation if the minimum number of participants is not met. In such a case, you will be notified via email and receive a full refund through your original method of payment.

Please note:

A valid passport is required for all travelers. If you forget your documentation, you will be denied border crossing and no refund will be issued.

Thank you for your understanding.
data.booking_notes:
Thank you for booking the Ensenada Pacific Coastline Tour with us!

Your guide will meet you at your designated pick-up point at 9:00 AM. Please arrive at least 10 minutes early.

This full-day experience includes round-trip transportation, bilingual guide, and a cultural journey through Ensenada’s main highlights.

Meals are not included; lunch is at your own expense. Your guide will help you find great options based on your tastes.

A valid passport is required to cross into Mexico and return to the U.S.

Wear comfortable walking shoes, and bring sunscreen, a hat, and extra cash for purchases or tips.

We look forward to sharing the charm of Ensenada with you!
